title: Agentic AI for Discovering Fault-Tolerant Quantum Circuits
abstract: arXiv:2611.18504v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scaling quantum computing toward practical quantum advantage is currently limited by the efficiency of circuits that operate on information encoded by quantum error-correcting codes. The full stack of quantum computing encompasses several tasks: preparation of logical code states, implementation of logical gates, logical routines on encoded qubits, etc. Yet, these circuits are largely designed by hand for individual cases, with some recent works incorporating machine learning for certain aspects. We formulate this problem as agentic evolutionary program synthesis, wherein a large language model, leveraging its pretraining knowledge and tool-use proficiency, and guided by a circuit verifier, evolves a program that defines a Clifford circuit for a wide range of curated tasks such as logical state preparation, logical gate design, and logical routines such as code-switching, code growth, etc. Our approach consistently finds fault-tolerant

translated_title: 用于发现容错量子线路的智能体人工智能
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.18504v1 公告类型：cross。摘要：将量子计算扩展到实用化的量子优势，目前受限于基于量子纠错码编码信息运行的线路效率。量子计算的完整技术栈涵盖若干任务：逻辑码态的制备、逻辑门的实现、以及作用于编码量子比特的逻辑例程等。然而，这些线路目前大多是为单个案例手工设计的，近期仅有一些工作在某些方面引入了机器学习。我们将这一问题表述为智能体式进化程序合成：大型语言模型利用其预训练知识和工具使用能力，并在电路验证器的引导下，进化出一个程序，该程序为一系列精心挑选的任务定义克利福德线路，包括逻辑态制备、逻辑门设计，以及码切换、码增长等逻辑例程。我们的方法能够持续找到容错的（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将容错量子线路的设计问题表述为智能体式进化程序合成，利用大型语言模型在电路验证器引导下自动进化生成用于逻辑态制备、逻辑门设计和码切换等任务的容错克利福德线路，从而取代传统的手工设计方法。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates fault-tolerant quantum circuit design as agentic evolutionary program synthesis, where a large language model guided by a circuit verifier automatically evolves fault-tolerant Clifford circuits for tasks such as logical state preparation, logical gate design, and code-switching, replacing manual circuit design.
